name: secret-guard
description: Blocks API keys, tokens and private keys from being written to disk, put on a command line, or committed to git by Claude.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: More secrets to block, one per entry, written Name=regex (for example: Mehfil API key=mhf_[A-Za-z0-9]{32})

skipPaths.title: Skip paths
skipPaths.description: Glob patterns for files whose content is never scanned. Secrets files like .env are still blocked from git.

gitCheckpoint.title: Git checkpoint
gitCheckpoint.description: Check git add and git commit for secrets files and staged secrets
